name: Synthesia
description: Let agents find your Synthesia videos and templates: each video's status, length, thumbnail and download link, so campaigns can point to finished videos. Read-only.
identity: A Synthesia API key. It acts as the person who created it, with their access to videos in the workspace.

setup.title: Create an API key
setup.body: Your Synthesia plan decides whether you can create API keys. The key needs the Legacy (v2) scope, which the video API asks for. Synthesia shows the key only once.
click: In Synthesia, select Developers in the sidebar, then the API keys tab.
Select New API key, name it Agents, grant the Legacy (v2) scope and choose when it expires.
Select Create API key and copy the key.

capabilities.label: Read videos and templates
capabilities.description: List videos and templates, and read one video: its status, length, thumbnail, captions and download link.
capabilities.note: Reaches the videos the key's owner can see in the workspace. Read-only.

revoke: In Synthesia, select Developers, then API keys, and disable or delete the key. Agents lose access to Synthesia at once.
